purpose: Fictional video meeting participants; source portraits for actual Weblink UI screenshots.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: fictional participant webcam feed for a real video-conferencing app screenshot.
Primary request: generate one realistic, friendly adult participant on a work video call, looking toward their laptop webcam.
Composition: landscape 16:9 single photo, medium chest-up framing, full head with generous headroom, centered subject. Natural laptop-webcam perspective, realistic skin texture, soft daylight, polished but candid rather than studio headshot. Quiet softly focused home office background. Keep the person's face and shoulders inside the middle half so the image works in a small conference tile.
Constraints: exactly one fictional adult, no resemblance to a celebrity, no text, names, logos, watermarks, meeting controls, frames, collage, other people, visible monitor or hands. Opaque background.
Subject and setting: A fictional East Asian man in his early 30s, short black hair, a navy overshirt over a light gray T-shirt, relaxed subtle smile. Warm neutral home office with a blurred plant and bookcase.
